scope: Every file in the verified live baseline and final public tree, including file names; ignored local backups, drafts and Git metadata are excluded.
keyword_review: Token matches describe generation metrics, limits and tokenizer code. Key matches describe JSON/program structure or redaction rules. Password and secret are redaction categories, not values. Authorization and Bearer appear in the generic client header constructed from a user-provided environment variable. No credentials are embedded.
reviewed_code_false_positive_details: Three standard Python home-directory calls matched the private-DNS pattern; they are standard Python API calls, not hostnames.
One Python slice using a double colon matched the IPv6 pattern; it is code syntax, not a network address.
limitations: Pattern scan plus review of static scripts and data fields; public project/model names, upstream URLs, commit/model hashes and relative source paths are retained. No scanner proves absence of all possible sensitive data.
